EGOI-problems.json.verification_notes: Competition tasks of both days, numbered per day as in the contest. Each statement is transcribed from the official English task statement published on the EGOI statistics site and checked section by section (input/output format, constraints, subtasks, sample tests, figures) against its page images. Statements only: no solutions, editorials or test data; the sample tests printed in the statement stay.

IOI-problems.json.verification_notes: Competition tasks of both days (Day 0 practice tasks are not included), numbered per day as in the contest. Each statement is transcribed from the official English task statement in the IOI archive and checked section by section (input/output format, constraints, subtasks, sample tests, figures) against its page images. Statements only: no solutions, editorials or test data; the sample tests printed in the statement stay.
